build_flip_transform: build a GeneralRandomFlip transform to flip images, bounding boxes, and segmentation maps horizontally or vertically
build_resize_compensate_transform: build a RandomGeneralResizeCompensate transform to resize depth maps and masks to match resized image dimensions
build_crop_transform: build a RandomGeneralCrop transform to randomly crop images, masks, and depth values to a specified crop size
build_pack_inputs_transform: build a PackGeneralInputs transform to pack images and depth maps into SegDataSample tensors for model input
build_generate_target_transform: build a GenerateGeneralTarget transform to set background values and create depth map targets from ground truth values
